changelog: Fixed: TikTok Short Drama episode links (tiktok.com/shortdrama/episode/...) now download instead of failing with "Unsupported URL"
Fixed: A Short Drama link without an episode number downloads Episode 1, the same episode TikTok opens
Improved: A removed or region-unavailable TikTok Short Drama now fails once with a clear message instead of retrying
Fixed: TikTok MP3 downloads no longer fail with "output file not found" after the audio is converted
Fixed: Automatic update notifications — the "Update Available" prompt and status-bar button now appear when a new version is released
